title: A Comprehensive Survey on Learning from Rewards for Large Language Models: Reward Models and Learning Strategies
paper_type_zh: 奖励模型与学习策略综述
best_for_zh: 关于偏好对、标量奖励、奖励模型和学习策略的综述。
one_line: A 2025 EMNLP Findings survey that maps reward signals from feedback collection through training, inference, and post-inference correction.
一篇把奖励信号从反馈收集延伸到训练、推理与后处理的 2025 EMNLP Findings 综述。
why: It prevents Track0 readers from collapsing preference data, reward models, optimization objectives, and judge outputs into one undifferentiated “RLHF” label.
inclusion_reason: A recent foundation for distinguishing preference pairs, scalar rewards, trained reward models, reward-guided inference, and post-hoc feedback before entering specialized feedback-data tracks.

title: Problem
问题
html: Post-training discussions often use “RLHF” as shorthand for incompatible objects: pairwise preferences, scalar rewards, learned reward models, direct objectives, and inference-time selectors. The official Findings of EMNLP 2025 record at https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.970/ frames learning from rewards as the transition from static-data learning to dynamic feedback. This Card maps those objects before readers enter preference/reward tracks; it does not release a new reward dataset. Its evaluation surface is the reward signal's role at training, inference, or post-inference time.

后训练讨论常把“RLHF”当作不相同对象的简称：偏好对、标量奖励、学习到的奖励模型、直接优化目标和推理时选择器。官方 Findings of EMNLP 2025 页面 https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.970/ 将 learning from 奖励s 描述为从静态数据学习转向动态反馈。本卡先划分这些对象；它不发布新的奖励数据集。其评测面是奖励信号在训练、推理或后推理阶段的作用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey's central taxonomy joins two axes: reward models and learning strategies. It places RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, GRPO, reward-guided decoding, and post-hoc correction in a broader learning-from-rewards view, while also discussing reward-model benchmarks and applications. Its contribution to the atlas is the feedback contract: record who or what supplies a signal, whether it is a pair, score, critique, or model output, and whether it is used to train, select, or correct. Compare it with primary feedback releases, not as a replacement for their annotation protocols.
该综述的核心 分类框架连接两条轴：奖励模型与学习策略。它把 RLHF、RLAIF、DPO、GRPO、奖励引导解码和后处理修正置于更宽的 learning-from-奖励s 框架，同时讨论奖励模型基准与应用。它给 atlas 的贡献是反馈契约：记录信号由谁或什么产生、它是成对偏好、分数、批评还是模型输出，以及它被用于训练、选择还是修正。它应与一级反馈发布物对照，而不能取代其标注协议。

title: Method
方法
html: This survey synthesizes methods rather than building a reward model. The official abstract says it reviews reward models and learning strategies across training, inference, and post-inference stages, alongside benchmarks and applications. For a routed primary paper, retain the provenance of preference comparisons or scores, the annotator or judge identity, model-training objective, target domain, calibration and overoptimization tests, and whether evaluation uses an independent judge or a task verifier. The official ACL page, DOI, and arXiv record are citation artifacts; code and data are unknown/null for this survey.
这篇综述综合方法，而不训练一个奖励模型。官方摘要说明它覆盖训练、推理和后推理阶段的奖励模型与学习策略，以及 基准和应用。记录相关论文时，应保留偏好比较或分数的来源、标注者或 裁判模型身份、模型训练目标、目标领域、校准与过优化测试，以及评测使用的是独立 裁判模型还是任务 验证器。ACL 页面、DOI 和 arXiv 是引文 发布产物；对本综述而言代码和数据为 未知/空。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official ACL record verifies the sole author, Findings of EMNLP 2025 venue, DOI, pages, and abstract. The abstract directly supports the survey's stated coverage of RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, GRPO, reward-guided decoding, and post-hoc correction. It does not establish a shared empirical ranking of those approaches.
官方 ACL 页面核验了唯一作者、Findings of EMNLP 2025 会议信息、DOI、页码和摘要。摘要直接支持该综述覆盖 RLHF、RLAIF、DPO、GRPO、奖励引导解码和后处理修正的说法；它并未为这些方法给出共同的实证排名。

title: Novelty
新意
html: RLHF and reward modeling predate this paper. Its direction signal is the stage-spanning view: reward learning can drive training, guide decoding, and support later correction, while reward-model evaluation remains a separate question. That separation matters for reasoning data because a high-scoring output is not necessarily a verified answer. Before reuse, inspect reward hacking, domain shift, judge agreement, and the independence of the evaluator.
RLHF 与奖励建模早于此文。它的方向信号是跨阶段视角：奖励学习可驱动训练、引导解码并支持后续修正，而奖励模型评测仍是独立问题。对 推理 数据，这种区分很关键，因为高分输出不等于被验证的答案。复用前应检查 奖励 hacking、领域偏移、裁判模型一致性和评测者独立性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper is a survey, so licenses, splits, annotation procedures, and contamination controls belong to the individual datasets and benchmarks it cites. A common reward vocabulary should not be read as a guarantee of comparability or correctness.
该文是综述，许可证、划分、标注流程和污染控制应回到它引用的各个数据集与 基准。共同的奖励词汇并不保证可比性或正确性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey separates feedback records, reward models, learning strategies, benchmarks, and applications. It presents these as related but distinct elements of learning from rewards, so a preference pair, a learned reward, a decoding method, and a judge-based evaluation are not collapsed into one object.
综述区分反馈记录、奖励模型、学习策略、基准和应用。它将这些视为 learning from 奖励s 中彼此相关但不同的组成部分，因此 偏好对、学习得到的 奖励、解码 方法与 裁判模型-based 评测不会被合并为同一种对象。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Rewards may come from people, AI, rules, or environments, and they can guide training, inference, or post-processing. Understanding learning from rewards starts with separating where a reward comes from, what it represents, and what part of a system it actually changes.
奖励既可以来自人，也可以来自 AI、规则或环境，并能进入训练、推理和后处理的不同环节。理解“从奖励中学习”的关键，是区分奖励的来源、它表示什么，以及它在系统中实际驱动了什么。
